objective: Close real Linux product integration gap: native_layout.json mapped 13 privileged managed code files only, yet real v1.5.7 Linux user_update_transaction manages 8 separate user-scope code files. NativePlan from one scope could never match the R899 broker requirement of exactly protected+user.
decision: Upsert original linux/native_layout.json in place, retaining exact 13 Root entries and adding all eight authentic user managed code entries as recorded in linux/app/user_update_transaction.py FILES. Keep mutable router_gateway/providers.json and other user settings OUT of code scope. No product installer or systemd service altered.

accepted_real_source_contract.source_package_generation: Read-only static ast.literal_eval of preexisting build_linux_package.py FILES declarations. Real file bytes hashed with same LF normalization as packaging script; the packaging script was NOT executed and no release ZIP overwritten or published.
accepted_real_source_contract.broker_intent: compiled actual 21-code-file NativePlan matches R899 exact two-scope policy/request/manifest SHA contract; no source-only plan grants native acceptance
accepted_real_source_contract.bundle_materialization: Actual repo 21 managed code members pinned in a synthetic distribution, then privileged output 13 files and user output 8 files separately materialized under temporary roots; synthetic Engine staged/activated/committed code only with callback stubs; customizable providers and owner settings preserved byte-for-byte.

verification.initial_test_negative: First new user materialization test supplied only eight user members in distribution; shared compiler correctly refused because all 21 layout-declared source entries must be pinned before materializing one scope.
verification.test_fix: Test now includes all 21 source inputs and materializes only user scope; rerun 26/26 PASS; core code unchanged.

risk_limits: The actual version 1.5.7 release remains private/unpublished; no publisher-signature or independently authenticated package provenance
No actual installed Linux root/user upgrade, systemd/polkit grant, protected FD-write adapter or reboot test
Mutable router_gateway providers explicitly excluded from managed code but must be preserved by the native transaction when enabled
Windows remains separately defined by windows/manifest.json v1.5.7 and Inno; not modified in R903
